Thanks for the suggestion. Early feature or method ideas are also welcome in
[Ideas](https://github.com/Pascal-Kueng/dyadMLM/discussions/categories/ideas),
where they can be talked through before implementation.

## What would you like to improve?

What problem or workflow do you have in mind, and what would you like dyadMLM
to do?

## Context

If useful, include the relevant dyad or study structure, model engine or family,
a small example, or a methodological reference.

## Interested in helping?

If you would like to help test, document, review, or implement the idea, let us
know.

Please only share data you are permitted to make public. Never upload
identifiable or confidential research data.
